```{r Implementation}
df <- read.csv("gistemp.csv", skip = 1, na.strings = "***")
monthly_matrix <- as.matrix(df[, 2:13])
monthly_vector <- as.numeric(t(monthly_matrix))

gistemp_ts_raw <- ts(monthly_vector, start = c(1880, 1), frequency = 12)

# Eliminating seasonality
stl_decomp <- stl(gistemp_ts_raw, s.window = "periodic")
gistemp_ts <- gistemp_ts_raw - stl_decomp$time.series[,"seasonal"]

```

# Dynamic linear models

```{r rw and llt}

```

# Parameter estimation

```{r params estimation}
# builder functions
build_rw <- function(params) {
  dlmModPoly(order = 1, dV = params[1], dW = params[2])
}
build_llt <- function(params) {
  dlmModPoly(order = 2, dV = params[1], dW = c(params[2], params[3]))
}
set.seed(88888)
start_rw <- c(1,1)
start_llt <- c(1,1,1)

# ML estimation - rw
mle_rw <- dlmMLE(gistemp_ts,
                  parm = start_rw,
                  build = build_rw,
                  hessian = TRUE
                  )
# output - rw
sigma2_rw <- mle_rw$par[1]
tau2_rw <- mle_rw$par[2]
se_rw <- sqrt(diag(solve(mle_rw$hessian)))

# - llt
mle_llt <- dlmMLE(gistemp_ts,
       parm = start_llt,
       build = build_llt,
       hessian = TRUE
       )

# output - llt
sigma2_llt <- mle_llt$par[1]
tau2_llt <- mle_llt$par[2]
gamma2_llt <- mle_llt$par[3]
se_llt <- sqrt(diag(solve(mle_llt$hessian)))

mle_table <- data.frame(
  Model     = c("RW", "RW", "LLT", "LLT", "LLT"),
  Parameter = c("sigma^2", "tau^2", "sigma^2", "tau^2", "gamma^2"),
  MLE       = c(sigma2_rw, tau2_rw, sigma2_llt, tau2_llt, gamma2_llt),
  SE        = c(se_rw, se_llt)
)
knitr::kable(mle_table, digits = 6, caption = "MLE estimates and asymptotic standard errors")
```

# Filtering and smoothing

# note that the following are the fitted models:
mod_rw  <- build_rw(mle_rw$par)
